_comment: What the game does for a few species by number. The C holds none of it: a species without a row gets no special treatment. modelScale: the model is drawn at `percent` of its size (the original: Meteormon, 113, at 150). animatedTexture: the species whose texture is animated (the flames of the fire Digimon): `width` is the width of the strip of the texture that moves (9 Agumon-line species of the original). Up to 8 scales and 16 animated textures. The battle music of a species is its own `battle_music`; the last-battle track rule is battle-formulas.json (music).
